## Description
 Used in the oxidation of ammonia (NH3)&#10;&#9;&#9;to nitrite (NO2−) in the nitrification of waste water.

## Characteristics

| Attribute      | Value |
|--------:|:------|
|Edible:|false|
|Type:|Organism|
|Form:|Solid|
